# autodiff.controls.gaussian_basis { #clerq.autodiff.controls.gaussian_basis }

```python
autodiff.controls.gaussian_basis(t, n, lo=None, hi=None, width=None)
```

Gaussian bumps on a regular grid of centres, evaluated at the times ``t``.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name   | Type          | Description                                                                                                              | Default    |
|--------|---------------|--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| t      | ArrayLike     | sample times, shape ``(n_t,)``.                                                                                          | _required_ |
| n      | int           | number of basis functions (at least 2).                                                                                  | _required_ |
| lo     | float \| None | first centre; default the first time.                                                                                    | `None`     |
| hi     | float \| None | last centre; default the last time. Use a ``hi`` below the last time to confine a control to an earlier window.          | `None`     |
| width  | float \| None | standard deviation of each bump; default the centre spacing, which makes neighbouring bumps overlap enough to be smooth. | `None`     |

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type       | Description                                                           |
|--------|------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | np.ndarray | ``B``, shape ``(n_t, n)``, so that a control is ``B @ coefficients``. |
